summary: Shengfeng Development Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice of extraordinary general meeting and proxy statement. The meeting will consider a share consolidation (reverse stock split) of 30-to-1 (or such lesser ratio as the board determines, not less than 2-to-1) and adoption of amended and restated memorandum. No price, premium, stake, or deal terms stated. This is a routine corporate action to maintain listing standards, not a special situation. The filing is a shareholder meeting notice without any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change.
